memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica: status – moderate low back pain radiating to left leg, straight leg raise positive. Plan – continue pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; advise lumbar extension exercises; review in 8 weeks.
- Gout: status – asymptomatic, serum uric acid pending. Plan – start allopurinol 100 mg OD; monitor creatinine and uric acid in 4 weeks.
- Weight: 78 kg; waist circumference 92 cm (male cutoff 90 cm) – central obesity. Diet advice – breakfast: whole grain roti with egg white; lunch: dal, vegetable curry, small rice portion; dinner: light soup, salad.
- Due: next HbA1c due 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: L4-L5 disc bulge causing mild indentation of the thecal sac, no cord compression. Mild degenerative changes at L3-L4. No significant nerve root edema.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Orthopaedics, Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences, for opinion on lumbar disc bulge and persistent sciatica. Requested clinical correlation and possible physiotherapy referral.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Orthopaedic opinion: conservative management advised. Continue medications, physiotherapy core strengthening, avoid heavy lifting. Repeat MRI in 6 months if symptoms worsen. No surgical indication at present.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica: status – mild occasional discomfort, well controlled. Plan – continue pregabalin, diclofenac, methylcobalamin; reinforce physiotherapy.
- Gout: status – acute flare in left first metatarsophalangeal joint 2 days ago, pain 8/10. Allopurinol stopped due to mild rash. Started febuxostat 40 mg OD and colchicine 0.5 mg BD for flare. Plan – monitor uric acid, creatinine, liver enzymes in 2 weeks.
- Weight: 76 kg; waist 88 cm (improved). Diet advice – breakfast: idli with sambar; lunch: roti, leafy veg, curd; dinner: dalia, steamed veg.
- Due: next HbA1c due 2026-04-15.
